What Crux cannot protect inside a signed-in site
While you are signed in, the site records what you view, how long you look, what you type and search, and what you tap. Crux cannot block this without making your account look like a modified client.
Ads are still chosen using your profile and counted as shown. Crux can hide some on screen, but the site still records them.
The site knows everything you do on it: follows, likes, messages, posts and searches.
All sites see the same IP address and device details, so visits can be linked even with separate profiles. Only a VPN changes the IP address.
Signing in with Google or Apple tells that company which service you use. Email and password avoids this.
Servers each site\'s page reached today, other companies first. Only host names are noted, never pages or what was sent. Kept in memory only and cleared at midnight or when Crux closes.
